title: Ellie visit analysis result (pee_v1)
description: Structured answer every analyser returns for one visit. Sent to Gemini as the response schema; local analysers must produce the same shape. 'reason' is shown to the owner, so it is Brazilian Portuguese.

pee.description: A NEW pee mark appears in AFTER that is not in BEFORE (old stains do not count).

poop.description: NEW poop in AFTER that is not in BEFORE, and where.

pad_replaced.description: The pad itself was changed or the tray cleaned between BEFORE and AFTER.

image_quality.description: Whether BEFORE/AFTER are usable for comparison.

reason.description: Short explanation in pt-BR, e.g. 'mancha nova e úmida no centro do tapete'.
